Timing-Allow-Origin (TAO) & Opaque Resource Boundary

This fixture embeds cross-origin assets where third-party servers omit the Timing-Allow-Origin response header. Browser engines restrict wire transfer sizes and sub-millisecond network phases for these resources to 0 to prevent length-based side-channel probing.

Observability Invariant: Telemetry gaps resulting from absent TAO headers or cross-origin isolation boundaries must be classified as OBSERVABILITY_LIMIT, lowering the Telemetry Coverage Index (TCI) without penalizing site quality category scores.
